Rockstar’s GTA 6 takeover continues in Miami:

- A boat with a giant “Welcome to Vice City” billboard
- Pier 5 has been transformed to VI with a themed Jetski
- Ferris wheel with the Vice City logo and themed lighting
- BOXR Gym rebranded to the in-game version (Zenith Gym)

- Club Space nightclub is rebranding to the in-game version (The Vault) on November 20th
- Themed Halloween party took place in Wynwood
96% complete until GTA 6 officially releases (15 days remaining).

The GTA 6 size could’ve easily exceeded 400GB without Rockstar’s compression techniques, according to dataminer Tex2.

Rockstar uses RPF compression and more efficient audio formats, which help keep game file sizes down.

GTA 6 pre-orders are about to surpass Cyberpunk 2077, which holds the record for most pre-orders (8 million).

The game isn’t even coming to PC at launch and it’s currently sitting at 7.71 million pre-orders ($751 million revenue) 2 weeks before release, according to Sensor Tower.

Nearly 1 out of every 3 console/PC gamers in the US plans to buy GTA 6, which is the highest level recorded for a video game, according to market research firm, Circana.

Rockstar just dropped a new GTA 6 screenshot and confirmed the game requires 212GB with pre-loading beginning earlier than expected on November 10th:

- Pre-loading begins at midnight for each region on PlayStation
- On Xbox, pre-loading begins globally on November 10 at 12am GMT
- Launch will be at midnight local on all consoles on November 19th
- A printable Leonida map and cover art poster will be available as a free digital download on the official site at launch
- A double-sided physical version of this poster will be available after launch from the Rockstar Store for $1 on its own or as a free gift with any purchase

(Source: https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/k4ak9okk485712/grand-theft-auto-vi-pre-load-begins-on-november-10?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=o_social&utm_campaign=gtavi_announcement_pre-load-20261103)

Grand Theft Auto VI pre-load begins on November 10. There’s still time to pre-order and ensure you're able to experience Grand Theft Auto VI when it launches on November 19.
